title: OOM killer terminated nginx causing 15 min downtime
symptoms: php-fpm consumed 95% of available RAM due to memory leak in v2.4.1
root_cause: PHP-FPM memory leak in application version 2.4.1 - child processes not releasing memory after request completion
resolution: 1. Restarted nginx and php-fpm services. 2. Temporarily reduced pm.max_children from 50 to 30. 3. Deployed hotfix v2.4.2 that fixed the memory leak. 4. Set up proactive memory monitoring with alert at 80%.
follow_up: Upgrade php-fpm to v8.3, add pm.max_requests=500 to force child recycling
